title: 云依助手 0.13.2
releaseNotes: Refreshes System Center, Port Manager and Software Uninstaller with coordinated slate-blue surfaces and category and status colors. System Center retains all fields in four detail tabs. Port operations stay fully visible with an internally scrolling table and responsive long values. Custom process, uninstall and cleanup confirmations are centered in the whole client. Removes the permanent port safety footer while preserving explicit confirmation and native protections. All 20 built-in tools and the packaged pink Yiyi character are retained.
